payload.title: Publish meaningful progress during exhaustive portfolio ranking
payload.description:
Account-wide ranking can spend many minutes between the initial Report revision and the completed ranking milestone. During that interval the living Report remains at zero and operators cannot distinguish active scorecard enumeration, feedback analysis, or a stalled worker.

Feature: Observable exhaustive ranking

Scenario: Ranking advances
  Given an exhaustive portfolio ranking is running
  When scorecard pages, activity evidence, or feedback batches complete
  Then the existing living Report publishes throttled aggregate progress
  And it reports inspected versus discovered scorecards or completed versus total analysis work when totals are known
  And it reports elapsed time and the next checkpoint
  And it does not expose opaque identifiers or create a workbook revision per page

Scenario: Ranking stalls or fails
  Given no ranking progress has been recorded within the documented heartbeat interval
  When an operator views the Report
  Then the Report distinguishes delayed, retrying, incomplete, and failed states from ordinary active progress.

No client information is included.
